closed_findings: outputs were not bound to an actual evaluator run
duplicate JSON keys were not rejected
same-name concurrent writer could be signed
run-id reuse could overwrite an archived log
receipt booleans and integers were not exact-type checked
CSV value parsing accepted overflow and arbitrary strings
staging bytes were not hashed before publish
completed did not require a real staging publish
published bytes were not required to equal staged bytes

verified_controls: pinned evaluator bytes are compiled and executed directly
archived-reference __file__ is mapped to the active Route-C directory only to preserve HERE-relative semantics
three evaluator output writes are redirected to a unique immutable run-id staging directory
staged, published and compared output SHA256 maps must all match
completed requires child exit zero, complete staging, performed publish, complete output set, matching maps and unchanged source/runner
JSON duplicate keys and non-finite constants fail closed
CSV values accept only finite floats or three explicit evaluator sentinels
receipt fixed fields use exact type and value checks
child log bytes and SHA256 are checked
each compared file is read once and the same bytes feed parsing, hashing and comparison
